listing.name: F.E.A.R. (Xbox 360) — F.E.A.R. 360 Recompiled (Juansolo457)
listing.summary: Upstream reports base-game boot, menus, intro videos, campaign and Instant Action, with display-paced high-frame-rate fixes and checkpoint/Continue behavior. Full base campaign and the 360 bonus mission have not been completely checked; Interval2 GPU spikes, soft fonts and other effects/performance work remain. Steam Deck evidence uses experimental Proton; native Linux is untested and Android ARM64 not started. No Portcove runtime or gameplay qualification. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own Xbox 360 F.E.A.R. title565507D9 default.xex and Game/ under port-nx/assets/. Exact region/revision/hash is not established by this retained README; inspect docs/SETUP.md before source acceptance. F.E.A.R. Files title565507E8 belongs to its separate catalog game. Optional PC textures require the corresponding owned PC files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Upstream v0.1.0 releases are source only. On Windows, prepare the patched SDK with tools/setup-sdk.ps1 and locally build the base game with tools/build-nx.ps1 from the owned disc profile. tools/launch.ps1 -Collection is an optional shared game-selection route after each title is separately prepared. No public compiled game/player archive is offered by the reviewed README; original files stay in the local assets folder.
